name: Classroom
desc: Where the ordinary version of a character exists, until something interrupts it.
tags: classroom, rows of wooden school desks, chairs, chalkboard, chalk tray, teacher's desk, tall windows with curtains, sunlight falling across the desks, wall clock, bulletin board, wooden floor
prose: a classroom of wooden desks in rows facing a chalkboard, a teacher's desk in front of it and tall windows down one side laying bars of sunlight across the floor
note: The anime path defaults hard to the Japanese classroom: window wall on the left, sliding door at the back, sunset outside. Useful when that is what you want and a trap otherwise - for anything western, name a whiteboard, separate single desks and carpet, or the default wins anyway. Decide occupancy explicitly too: an unqualified classroom arrives full of students, and background students come out with mangled faces.
